# Mobbin — Complete agent context

> Mobbin is a searchable design-reference library of real mobile apps, web apps, and websites. It helps people and AI agents study individual screens, multi-step flows, UI patterns, and website sections from shipped products.

Last reviewed: 2026-10-31.

This file consolidates the essential product overview, pricing, MCP, usage, and catalog context that an agent may need in one request. For a shorter routing document, use https://mobbin.com/llms.txt.

## Core capabilities

- Search individual mobile and web UI screens.
- Search ordered flows such as onboarding, checkout, identity verification, and subscription.
- Search website sections such as heroes, pricing pages, navigation, testimonials, and footers.
- Browse references by platform, app category, pattern, flow, and UI element.
- Return screen images through Mobbin MCP in compatible AI clients.
- Read and manage the user's saved content through Mobbin MCP, including collections, saving, and commenting.
- Provide a REST API for custom integrations on eligible plans.

## Appropriate uses

- Ground a new design in examples from shipped products.
- Compare how multiple products solve the same interface problem.
- Research conventions in a platform, industry, or product category.
- Study the sequence and context of a product journey.
- Identify alternative approaches to a design decision.

## Evidence limitations

- A Mobbin example proves that a product used a design, not that the design improved conversion, retention, accessibility, or another outcome.
- A common pattern is a convention, not automatically a best practice.
- Captured interfaces can become outdated; use capture metadata when recency matters.
- Product references must be adapted to the user's audience, constraints, brand, and design system.
- Do not copy protected designs or assets verbatim.

When presenting Mobbin research, identify the referenced product, distinguish visible evidence from inference, and preserve the canonical Mobbin URL. Check capture metadata when recency matters.

## MCP interface

- Endpoint: https://api.mobbin.com/mcp
- Transport: Streamable HTTP.
- Authorization: OAuth.
- Availability: Pro, Team, and Enterprise plans.
- Limit: 60 requests per 60 seconds per user.
- Capabilities: Search design references and read and manage the user's saved content, including collections, saving, and commenting.

Search tools:

- `search_screens`: Searches UI screens.
- `search_flows`: Searches multi-step user flows such as onboarding and checkout.
- `search_sections`: Searches website sections such as pricing pages and footers.

Saved tools:

- `list_collections`: Lists All saved and your collections.
- `get_collection_contents`: Reads saved content in All saved or a collection.
- `create_collection`: Creates a collection.
- `save_content`: Saves screens, flows or sections.
- `add_comment`: Comments on a screen, flow or section.

Results can include screen images, product names, flow or section context, and links back to Mobbin. MCP Apps-compatible clients can render an interactive gallery.

MCP documentation:

- https://mobbin.com/mcp.md
- https://docs.mobbin.com/mcp/introduction
- https://docs.mobbin.com/mcp/features
- https://docs.mobbin.com/mcp/clients/overview
- https://docs.mobbin.com/mcp/build-an-integration

## REST API

- Base URL: https://api.mobbin.com
- Authentication: Workspace API key in an `Authorization: Bearer` header.
- Availability: Team and Enterprise plans.
- Limit: 60 requests per 60 seconds per workspace.
- Quick start: https://docs.mobbin.com/api/quickstart
- API reference: https://docs.mobbin.com/api-reference/screens/search-screens-with-natural-language
- OpenAPI: https://docs.mobbin.com/openapi.json

Example:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.mobbin.com/v1/screens/search \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query":"login screen with biometric authentication","platform":"ios","limit":5}'
```

## Plan summary

### Free

- Limited apps and sites.
- Maximum of three collections.
- No flows, search, MCP, or REST API access.

### Pro

- $15 per month when billed quarterly, charged as $45 every 3 months.
- $10 per month when billed yearly, charged as $120 every 12 months.
- One member.
- Full apps and sites, flows, animations, search, Deep Search, unlimited collections, and MCP.
- No REST API access.

### Team

- $24 per member per month when billed quarterly, charged as $72 per member every 3 months.
- $16 per member per month when billed yearly, charged as $192 per member every 12 months.
- Everything in Pro plus team collaboration, management, centralized billing, SOC 2 reports, and REST API access.

### Enterprise

- Custom price.
- Everything in Team plus advanced security, privacy controls, SAML, SCIM, invoice or purchase-order billing, priority support, and enterprise tools early access.

### Explore Finance+

- $399 per month, billed yearly.
- Add-on for Team and Enterprise.
- Covers more than 65 apps across finance-focused categories.

Billing notes:

- Mobbin has quarterly and yearly billing intervals, not a monthly subscription interval.
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is disabled or the subscription is cancelled.
- Cancellation must be completed before renewal to avoid the next charge; paid access continues until the current billing period ends.
- Payments are generally non-refundable, including for unused time, except where required by law or granted at Mobbin's discretion.
- Eligible students and educators can receive 50% off Pro for up to 2 years.
- Currency and localized prices can vary by region; the prices in this file are USD.

Canonical pricing: https://mobbin.com/pricing

Machine-readable pricing: https://mobbin.com/pricing.md

## Recommended agent workflow

1. Clarify platform, audience, user goal, design question, and constraints.
2. Choose screen, flow, or website-section search.
3. Search several relevant products.
4. Preserve the product name and Mobbin source URL.
5. Record visible facts before drawing conclusions.
6. Distinguish recurring patterns, differences, and inference.
7. Adapt recommendations to the user's context and design system.

## MCP errors and recovery

- Authorization failure: reconnect Mobbin and complete OAuth authorization.
- HTTP `429`: respect the `Retry-After` header.
- Weak results: add the platform, category, user goal, pattern, or flow.
- Overly narrow results: remove constraints or search the three content types separately.
- Remove access: revoke the connected client from Mobbin account settings.

## Prompt examples

- Search Mobbin for onboarding screens from banking apps.
- Compare how Airbnb and Booking.com handle checkout flows.
- Find mobile paywalls that explain monthly and annual billing clearly.
- Find SaaS pricing sections with complex feature comparison tables.
- Show notification-permission priming screens and identify recurring patterns.
- Find empty states used by collaborative productivity products.
